𝗔𝗕𝗛𝗜𝗦𝗛𝗘𝗞 𝗘𝗫𝗣𝗟𝗢𝗗𝗘𝗦! 🇮🇳

113 off 38 balls as India chase 199 in 13.2 overs, beating NZ by 6 wickets in Wellington.

133-run opening stand with Sooryavanshi. Series 3-0 🔥

#Cricket #INDvNZ

👉 Wellington T20I mein Abhishek Sharma: 113 (38 balls), 9 chauke, 11 chhakke
👉 India ne 199 ka target 13.2 over mein chase kiya
👉 Sooryavanshi ke saath 133 runs ki opening stand
👉 NZ ko 6 wicket se haraya, series 3-0
